maps.points.small_spider_cave.dialogue: Every step echoes through the clammy dark, where webs hang like curtains. You feel eyes on you. Many eyes.
maps.points.small_spider_cave.dialogue-1: Several large spiders cling to the walls ahead, perfectly still, waiting for prey to wander closer. "Ambush," you whisper. "Get ready before they strike."
Choose “Do you know what one spider said to the other?”
You glance at the thick webs hanging from the ceiling.
No one laughs. Not even the spiders.
You narrow your eyes, letting the heat bloom through the dark. Shapes shimmer in the distance. Eight-legged, crawling low.
"Spiders. Big ones," you growl. "Get ready before they notice us."
A hiss echoes through the tunnel. Dozens of eyes catch the light as the spiders rush forward.
maps.points.small_spider_cave.dialogue-2: "Do you know what one spider said to the other?" (Requires Wizard)
maps.points.small_spider_cave.dialogue-4: Echo Sight: Sense the danger. (Requires Echo Sight)
maps.points.small_spider_cave.dialogue-6: You crouch, scanning the floor for pressure plates or wires. Nothing.
maps.points.small_spider_cave.dialogue-9: You close your eyes for a moment. Tiny vibrations ripple through the stone and webbing around you.
